sql: WITH receita_corrente AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND dsc_cateconomica ILIKE '%Corrente%'), despesa_corrente_camara AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM despesa_despesa WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND dsc_naturezadespesa ILIKE '3%' AND CAST(cod_orgao AS INTEGER) = 1) SELECT (total_despesa / NULLIF(total_receita, 0)) * 100 AS perc_gasto_camara FROM receita_corrente CROSS JOIN despesa_corrente_camara;
